newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopian birr weakens further against the dollar.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopian birr weakens further against the dollar.

text.p: The Ethiopian birr weakened against the dollar on Monday, the National Bank of Ethiopia (NBE) said.
It quoted the birr at a mean rate of 6.8530 against the dollar compared to 6.8020 last week.
The bank said following a currency auction on June 21, the applicable rate for all transactions outside the auction in the June 23 to June 29 period would be 6.8530 birr to the dollar.

It said the highest bid rate at the forex auction on Saturday was 7.111 birr to the dollar whereas the lowest was 6.655. Bidders who offered rates of 6.853 and above per dollar won the full amount they tendered for, the bank added.
Total amount of foreign exchange made available at the auction on Saturday was $22 million, the bank said.
The bank posted the birr at a mean rate of 11.2951 against the pound from 11.1688 on Friday, while against the yen, the birr traded at 0.059830 from 0.060109 on Friday.
